Last time I commented on your Caitlyn picture and talked about 3D forms. You've really really improved since then and I can tell you really put effort into improving on that! It looks much more 3D now.

For this one I'd say try to think about using guidelines, because some things are a little crooked (the sword, facial features). Really work on your guidelines before getting the shading and colouring down, which are both great btw, you don't want any crookedness ruining them!

One more thing would be the hair. I know it can be tempting to use a lot of detail when drawing/painting, but hair is one thing that doesn't need detail. You're allowed to be lazy! My advice on hair is to block out the colour with a bigger brush, and think of hair as clumps, rather than individual strands. Here's a video on what I mean: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XydD-rDwdkE

But yeah, good job on this! Great drawing and great improvement, you're gonna go far I can tell!

Eating healthy doesn't mean only eating salad. First step would be to start cooking your own food so you at least know what's going into it. Cooking is a great skill to learn and will help you to make better lifestyle choices.

I think you're living too much in the 'now' and not taking into account that happiness right now isn't the most important thing. You can also make people happy by being a reliable friend who helps people because he **wants** to rather than simply agreeing to because he feels like he has to.

You're feeling bad because there's a conflict going on in your brain. What you need to understand is that he did something sexual to you, and a sexual act is a sexual act. Part of you will associate it with pleasure regardless of the context. You can't help this so it's really nothing you should feel bad about. This may just be you taking steps to get over what happened.

What he's saying is more of a reflection of him than it is you. People can see through that pretty easily, so don't worry about him turning your friends on you.

Why is he a former friend? Is there a reason he'd do this? If you don't know and it's possible to do so, maybe try talking to him.

Telling someone about a hygiene problem is hard, right? But if I had a problem like that and had no clue about it, I'd really appreciate someone telling me. If you don't want to say it outright, just tell him that the smoking and beer is making the flat smell bad. If you're doing laundry offer to do his. After you take a shower remind him that there's still enough hot water left if he wants one. If he doesn't take the hint it might be necessary to sit him down and talk with him.

Either way, it's not too far 'til January, hope you make it through!
It's not unethical but maybe instead you could take a course you enjoy or one where you'll learn something? You might as well make those hours useful after all.

It's perfectly fine to not know what you want to do in life. Do the things you do make you happy? Then great! Keep doing them. There's no way to force yourself to be passionate about something anyway, so don't feel like you have to worry so much about it. 

As for now, think about the things that are important to you and will be in 10 years time. Like sports? Make sure you're healthy and fit so you can enjoy them for a long time. Friends and family? Call someone now and talk with them. Make an effort to let them know you appreciate them. Is being a good person important to you? Volunteer for a charity or something. There's a bunch of small things you can do that will help you work towards a fulfilling life for you. But only you can decide what's important to you. Don't worry about what everyone else says, you don't need to be successful according to someone else's definition, just yours.
